'''Babs Terll''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and the owner of [[Cloudscape Tours]], a tour company in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After her husband [[Merl Terll|Merll]] had an accident in racing, she asked him to not race again.
